items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses the role of an 'alto player' in a band section generally and refers to a specific individual ('He') who replaced 'Doc' and was the leader, but does not explicitly state a personal relationship (e.g., friend, mentor, collaborator) with that specific alto player, nor does he

ctx.x: Yeah, and the guys got to follow you and if you and the first trombone player and the first alto player think alike in a band, they‘re the leaders of the section. And so if them guys think alike and play together, the band is going to come together. It‘s hard to answer that exactly, I mean, as far as I‘m concerned to put words to that, because it‘s not easy.

I think when you said you‘re the leader of that section, that you‘re the leader of that section, that‘s important, because you‘re the lead trumpet…the leading trumpet, you‘re the leader of that section.
